title: CRM and Vehicle Frontend
reason: Conditions 14 and 15 are complete as ACTIVITIES and their result is that the Backend read contracts P1-27 is scoped to consume do not exist. Thirteen of the twenty-nine Frontend tasks have no operation that returns the data they must display. Creating the feature branch would mean building screens against endpoints that are not there, which section 8 forbids and which no amount of Frontend care can repair.

Every CRM customer sub-resource is WRITE-ONLY over HTTP. Verified from source: addresses POST, contacts POST, consents POST, preferences PUT, notes POST, alerts POST, tags POST, restrictions POST. Only timeline and history export GET. There is no customers/[customerId]/route.ts at all, so no operation returns a customer.

Vehicle reads mostly exist: documents GET, ev-profile GET, history GET, odometer-readings GET, ownerships GET, plates GET, relationships GET. But vehicles/[vehicleId]/route.ts exports PATCH only — no vehicle detail read. No media route. No VIN validation contract.

P1-OD-017 (vehicle duplicate and merge rules) and P1-OD-025 (vehicle document and media policy) remain open. Section 13 forbids a merge action while P1-OD-017 is unresolved, which blocks FE-016 and FE-028 independently of the contract gaps.
